Description: Install and configure Nuxt UI in your Nuxt project
Do: pnpm add @nuxt/ui and add to modules

Guideline: Import Tailwind and Nuxt UI CSS
Description: Required CSS imports in main.css file
UApp provides global configs for Toast Tooltip and overlays
All Nuxt UI components use U prefix by default
Use semantic colors like primary secondary error
Nuxt UI provides solid outline soft subtle ghost link variants
Components support xs sm md lg xl sizes
Nuxt UI v4 uses Iconify i-prefix format — lucide:home is v3 legacy
Position icons with dedicated props for clarity
Runtime color configuration without restart
Define design tokens in CSS with Tailwind @theme
Register extra semantic color names at build time then map them to a palette in app.config
UForm supports Zod Yup Joi Valibot schemas
Provides label error message and validation display
UForm emits submit event with validated data
UForm validates on input blur and change by default; input is delayed and begins after blur unless eager
Do: Set validateOn and eager to match the interaction
Don't: Assume the default validates every keystroke immediately
Code Bad: Describe default UForm as eager input-only validation

Guideline: Use useOverlay composable for programmatic overlays
Description: Open overlays programmatically — v4 API is create().open() not open(Component)
Code Good: const modal = overlay.create(MyModal); const { result } = modal.open({ title: 'Confirm' })

Customize cell content with the documented column-id slot pattern

Description: Render a header control that calls column.toggleSorting

Automatic breadcrumb with NuxtLink support
Tab navigation with content panels

Static alert messages with icon and actions
Placeholder content during data loading
Built-in light/dark mode toggle button
Dropdown to select system light or dark mode

Description: Override component styles via ui prop

Description: Set component default variants under ui component keys
Runtime theme customization
Tree-shake unused component CSS

Description: Enable virtualization for 1000+ rows
Components have built-in ARIA support
Use UFormField or correct native id and for attributes

Guideline: Use UContentToc for table of contents
Description: Automatic TOC with active heading highlight
Command palette for documentation search

Enhanced textarea for AI prompts
TipTap-based editor binds its document with v-model

Auto-disable form during submit

Guideline: Let Nuxt UI declare module dependencies
Description: Nuxt UI uses Nuxt moduleDependencies for Icon Fonts and Color Mode ordering and registration
Do: Configure dependency options at their root keys
Don't: Add duplicate module entries without a documented need

Guideline: Use official templates to bootstrap projects
Description: Create a Nuxt project from an official Nuxt UI template
Code Bad: pnpm create nuxt app then copy dashboard files

Description: Install Iconify JSON collections used by the app; Nuxt UI 4.10 can bundle icons from installed collections
Don't: Rely on an unavailable collection at runtime
Code Bad: Use i-custom-* without installing its collection

Description: Components use default icons configurable via appConfig.ui.icons
Do: Set loading close check icons in app.config.ts
Don't: Accept default icons for all components

Do: UFileUpload with v-model and accept prop

Description: Locale-aware date picker built on UCalendar
Do: UInputDate with v-model and locale prop

Description: Multi-value tag input with keyboard support
Do: UInputTags with v-model and max prop

Description: Full-featured color picker with multiple format support
Do: UColorPicker with v-model and format prop

Description: Built-in tree component with expand/collapse
Do: UTree with items prop containing nested children

Guideline: Use UMarquee for infinite scroll content

Guideline: Await overlay result for confirmation dialogs
Description: useOverlay returns a result Promise resolving to user action
Code Good: const { result } = modal.open(); if (await result) { deleteItem() }

Description: Command palette supports grouped search with icons and kbds
Do: groups array with id label items

Description: Wire keyboard shortcuts from menu item kbds automatically
Don't: Manually duplicate shortcuts from menu items

Guideline: Use UHeader and UFooter for page layout
Description: Responsive header/footer with built-in mobile menu
Do: UHeader with #default slot for nav UFooter with columns

Description: Sidebar that hides below lg breakpoint automatically
Do: UPageAside for docs and landing page sidebars

Guideline: Wrap custom color mode toggles in ClientOnly
Description: Prevents hydration mismatch on server-rendered color mode
Don't: Direct useColorMode in template without ClientOnly

Guideline: Read generated theme file to find slot names
Description: Nuxt UI generates theme files listing all component slots and variants
Don't: Guess slot names or use trial-and-error

Description: whenever array condition prevents shortcut firing when inactive
Don't: Always-on shortcuts that fire in wrong context
Code Bad: defineShortcuts({ meta_enter: () => submit() }) // fires even when invalid

Guideline: Use UApp locale prop for internationalization
Description: Nuxt UI supports 50+ built-in locales via locale prop on UApp
Do: Import locale from @nuxt/ui/locale and pass to UApp
Don't: Manual translation of component UI strings
